ci-fix.label: Phrases that mark a CI fix
ci-fix.hint: Matched on whole words, any case.

merge-clash.label: Phrases that mark a merge clash
merge-clash.hint: Matched on whole words, any case.

second-try.label: Failed tries before it goes up
second-try.hint: A session that ran and ended in an error counts. A launch that never started or a usage limit does not.

contracts.label: Contract paths
contracts.hint: A path prefix, or a pattern with * (framework/spec/, *.schema.json).

contracts.label: Contract words
contracts.hint: Matched on whole words, any case.

blast-radius.label: Files that depend on what it touches
blast-radius.hint: Counted on the VPS from the step's files.

size.label: Lines changed
size.hint: 0 = off. Used when the size is known (a fix on an open PR).

cross-cutting.label: Areas touched
cross-cutting.hint: 0 = off. An area is one plugin, one app or one framework folder.

cross-cutting.label: Architecture words
cross-cutting.hint: Matched on whole words, any case.

designer.label: Keep the splitter's Opus as well
designer.hint: On: a step the splitting stage judged simple stays on Opus unless a rule above matched. Off: its suggestion only raises.
